summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist not persisting across login  ### What I found from a read-only audit I traced the full chain end-to-end without touching any files:  - **Frontend (`WatchlistPage.tsx`, `lib/api.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`):** All watchlist reads/writes go through `api.get/post/delete`, which sets `credentials: "include"` on every request. There's no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback for watchlist data anywhere in the client (only the theme toggle uses localStorage). `useAuth` resolves the signed-in user from `/api/auth/me` on mount and doesn't cache watchlist state itself. - **Sessi
